note: Thresholds are fixed before any run is collected. Changing them after data exists invalidates the evaluation; record a new version instead.

decision.go: net token reduction >= minNetTokenReduction with the confidence interval's upper bound below zero cost delta, accepted rate not below baseline, and claim incorrect rate within maxClaimIncorrectRate
decision.no-go: net token reduction is not positive, or accepted rate drops, or claim incorrectness exceeds the limit
decision.insufficient-data: fewer than minRunsPerArmPerClass runs in either arm

rollout.stableRequires: explicit controlled approval; promotion-policy.json autonomy is unchanged by default
rollout.rollback: set the project's docsAssist flag to off; agents fall back to direct code exploration and are never blocked by a missing index or backend
